name: Gruffudd Hiraethog
credit: No confirmed portrait sourced for this archive.
bio: Gruffudd Hiraethog (died 1564) was a Welsh bard and herald, best known as the teacher of the next generation of poets, among them Wiliam Llŷn and Siôn Tudur. He also compiled a Welsh dictionary and a collection of proverbs. He is not the nineteenth-century poet Gwilym Hiraethog.
The poem here is a couplet in George Borrow's English version, from Wild Wales, printed in Welsh Poems and Ballads (1915).

poems.title: The Satirist
poems.author: Gruffudd Hiraethog
poems.note: From "Wild Wales". Printed as "From Gruffydd Hiraethog".
poems.translator: trans. George Borrow (Welsh Poems and Ballads, 1915)
poems.text:
He who satire loves to sing,
On himself will satire bring.
